name: code101-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for faster, quieter sessions: file lookup, output trimming, code outlines, SSH, and speed profiles with a live panel for superpowers plan runs.

plugins.name: everything-find
plugins.description: Instant file/folder lookup via voidtools Everything (Windows).

plugins.name: output-trim
plugins.description: Trims noisy build/test/log output to errors, failures and summaries.

plugins.name: code-outline
plugins.description: Symbol outlines and single-symbol reads via tree-sitter (Rust, TS/JS, Python, C#).

plugins.name: ssh-remote
plugins.description: Run commands and download files over SSH, with credentials read from files Claude never sees.

plugins.name: superpowers-flow
plugins.description: Speed profiles (thorough, balanced, fast) for superpowers plan runs, chosen at the plan's handoff with the models per role; parallel slices in git worktrees or headless sessions; a live progress bar and agents panel; tiered sp-* workers; and a handoff that builds an approved EGM design.
